loremB.title: Lorem B: Extended Translation Dataset
loremB.p1: Another page with long translated blocks helps reveal edge-cases in fallback behavior and merged locale trees.
loremB.p2: It also gives better sample data for command outputs such as stats, estimate, lint, and optimize in the playground.
loremB.p3: Keeping this content verbose mirrors real-world landing pages where localization quality and consistency matter.
loremB.p4: Use this route to manually inspect rendering, locale switching, and the interaction between global and page dictionaries.
